The '''Sanctuary Pipeline''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that was created around [[3 ABY/Legends|3]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The Pipeline was created by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a route to quickly transport supplies and materials to the construction site of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. The [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route ran from [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], which was located right on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], which was the site chosen to build the massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]].

It was located above the galactic plane and was in the thick disk, but below the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]] that ran to [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] and the [[Kuna worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Murk-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoy in the [[Murk system/Legends|Murk system]].]]
The Pipeline was actually the expansion of a smaller previous hyperlane, the [[Silvestri Trace]], using [[S-thread booster/Legends|S-thread boosters]] to force open a route where one would not be possible naturally. The route's name reflected its purpose, as the primary pipeline for building materials on their way to the [[Endor/Legends|Sanctuary Moon]], the name given by the Imperials to the moon that the Death Star orbited. The hyperlane was heavily guarded, with [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] escorting [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ships going to and from the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="FFGBOTF">{{FFGTCG|set=Balance of the Force|cardname=Along the Sanctuary Pipeline}}</ref>
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] also utilized this route, to transfer their fleet for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault on the second Death Star]].

After the Battle of Endor, the Sanctuary Pipeline was later used by the travel agency Star Tours as a route to Endor. However, as the Empire was no longer present to maintain the route, it fell into decay, thus making it hazardous. Theft of S-thread boosters by criminals saw the Pipeline vanish shortly after the Battle of Endor.
